 SSC DELHI POLICE CAPF SI PAPER 2 CITY DETAILS 
 SSC SI Delhi Police and CAPFs Paper 2 Exam City 2025 Released, Admit Card Soon
 SSC has released exam city details for Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2025 Paper-II. The exam is scheduled for November 28, 2026. Candidates can check their exam city through the SSC login portal, while the admission certificate is expected 2–3 days before the exam.

 Important Instructions for SSC SI Paper 2 Candidates 
 Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released an official notice regarding the examination city details and admission certificate for candidates appearing in the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2025 (Paper-II). Candidates can now access their examination city information through the designated login module on the official SSC website.
 According to the notice dated November 18, 2026, SSC SI Paper 2 will be conducted on November 28, 2026. Candidates should check their allotted exam city and prepare for the examination accordingly. The admission certificate, which serves as the examination hall ticket, will tentatively be available for download 2–3 days before the exam.
 Candidates preparing for other SSC recruitment examinations can also refer to the SSC Exam Dates November 2026 update to track upcoming examination schedules.

 SSC SI Paper 2 Exam City Details 2025 Released
 SSC has provided access to examination city details through the designated candidate login module on its official website. Candidates appearing for Paper-II can log in to check their allotted examination city before the test.
 The city information is important for candidates who need to arrange travel, accommodation or other logistics ahead of the examination. Candidates should make sure they check the correct examination details under their login account.
 The examination city details and admission certificate can be viewed through the SSC portal. However, candidates must download the admission certificate separately once it becomes available, as city details alone are not a substitute for the hall ticket.
 How to Check SSC SI Paper 2 Exam City 2025?
 Candidates can check their SSC SI Paper 2 exam city by following the steps given below:
 Visit the official Staff Selection Commission website at ssc.gov.in .
 Open the candidate login section.
 Enter your registered login credentials.
 Sign in to the candidate portal.
 Locate the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2025 (Paper-II) section.
 Check the examination city details available in your login.
 Save the information and plan your travel accordingly.
 SSC SI Paper 2 Admit Card 2025 Release Date
 The SSC SI Delhi Police and CAPFs Paper 2 Admit Card 2025 is expected to be available for download 2–3 days before the exam date. Since the examination is scheduled for November 28, 2026, candidates can expect the admission certificate closer to the examination.
 The admission certificate will be available through the designated login module on the SSC website. Candidates should download it as soon as the link is activated and carefully verify their examination details.
 Candidates should not rely on the exam city details alone for entry to the examination centre. The admission certificate and other documents required by SSC must be carried as per the official instructions.
 For updates on other SSC examination hall tickets, candidates can also check the SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 release information page.
 SSC Paper 2 Exam City Slip vs Admission Certificate
 The exam city details and admission certificate are different. The city information is provided to help candidates know their allotted examination city in advance, while the admission certificate contains the information and instructions required for appearing in the exam.

 Important Instructions for SSC SI Paper 2 Candidates
 Candidates appearing for the SSC SI Paper 2 examination should keep the following points in mind:
 Check the allotted examination city through the official login module.
 Verify examination-related information available on the portal.
 Download the admission certificate when the link is activated.
 Read the instructions mentioned in the admission certificate carefully.
 Plan travel according to the allotted city.
 Keep checking the SSC website for any additional notice or update.
